cues.text: The sidebar, quick search, switching language, help on every page and the office on your phone.
Welcome to The Wave leasing office. Everything starts from the dashboard.
The sidebar groups every module: sales, property, revenue, finance, operations and more. You only see what your role allows.
A number next to a module means something is waiting for you, like approvals or overdue invoices.
Search finds any lead, brand, unit, offer or lease. Press Ctrl and K from anywhere to open it.
Start typing and the results appear instantly.
This button switches the whole office between English and Arabic. Your choice is remembered.
And this question mark opens the lessons for the page you are on, any time you need help.
Your name, your role and signing out are at the bottom of the sidebar.
On a phone, open the office in the browser and add it to your home screen: it works like an app, with a tab bar at the bottom.
